description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Border, which handles validation of the CSS 'border' property within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing the validator with configuration, and for validating a border property string according to CSS rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Border
classes.description: A class responsible for validating the CSS border property in the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with CSS border property definitions from the configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a border property string based on CSS rules, returning a sanitized value or false.
